scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Value Proposition
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with headline, subheadline, and primary CTA buttons visible above the fold

steps.description: Load the application root URL as an unauthenticated visitor
steps.context: User is not logged in and visits the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section is visible without scrolling on desktop viewport
Confirm the main headline clearly communicates the URL shortening service value
steps.context: Headline should be prominent and descriptive

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'Sign In' buttons are visible and properly styled
steps.context: Buttons should be easily identifiable and clickable

test_cases.input: Navigate to '/' route as unauthenticated user
test_cases.expected: Hero section renders with headline, subheadline, and CTA buttons visible

test_cases.input: Render Home component
test_cases.expected: Component contains heading element with product tagline text

test_cases.input: Render Home component and query for CTA buttons
test_cases.expected: Both 'Get Started' and 'Sign In' buttons are present in the DOM

test_cases.input: Check hero section at 1280x720 viewport
test_cases.expected: All hero content is visible without vertical scrolling

scenarios.name: Registration Navigation (Get Started CTA)
scenarios.description: Verify the 'Get Started' CTA button correctly navigates to the registration page

steps.description: Load the homepage as an unauthenticated user
Find the primary CTA button for registration
steps.context: Button should be prominent in hero section

steps.description: Click the registration CTA button
Confirm the URL changes to /register and registration page loads
steps.context: React Router should handle the navigation

test_cases.input: Click 'Get Started' button on homepage
test_cases.expected: User is navigated to '/register' route

test_cases.input: Render Home component with Router and simulate click on Get Started
test_cases.expected: Navigation function called with '/register' path

test_cases.input: Check Get Started button href or onClick handler
test_cases.expected: Button has correct navigation target to registration

scenarios.name: Login Navigation (Sign In CTA)
scenarios.description: Verify the 'Sign In' button correctly navigates to the login page

steps.description: Load the homepage as an unauthenticated user
Find the Sign In link/button in navigation or hero section
steps.context: Sign In should be accessible from the header navigation

steps.description: Click the login navigation button
Confirm the URL changes to /login and login page loads
steps.context: React Router should handle the navigation

test_cases.input: Click 'Sign In' button on homepage
test_cases.expected: User is navigated to '/login' route

test_cases.input: Render Home component with Router and simulate click on Sign In
test_cases.expected: Navigation function called with '/login' path

test_cases.input: Check Sign In button/link href or onClick handler
test_cases.expected: Element has correct navigation target to login

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section displays three key features: URL shortening, analytics, and dashboard management

Scroll down to locate the features section
steps.context: Features section should be below the hero

steps.description: Check that three feature cards are displayed with icons, titles, and descriptions
steps.context: Features: URL Shortening, Analytics, Dashboard Management

steps.description: Verify each feature card has meaningful content describing the capability
steps.context: Content should be informative and concise

test_cases.input: Render Home component and query features section
test_cases.expected: Features section contains exactly 3 feature cards

test_cases.input: Query feature cards for URL shortening feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card with title mentioning 'URL' or 'shortening' exists with description

test_cases.input: Query feature cards for analytics feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card with title mentioning 'analytics' or 'tracking' exists with description

test_cases.input: Query feature cards for dashboard feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card with title mentioning 'dashboard' or 'management' exists with description

test_cases.input: Navigate to homepage and scroll to features
test_cases.expected: All three feature cards are visible and properly styled

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile Viewport
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage displays correctly on mobile devices with collapsed navigation and touch-friendly elements

steps.description: Set viewport to mobile dimensions (375x667)
Load the homepage at mobile viewport
Check that all content fits within viewport width
Check that navigation collapses into hamburger menu
Check that buttons are appropriately sized for touch (min 44x44px)

test_cases.input: Load homepage at 375px viewport width
test_cases.expected: No horizontal scrollbar appears, content fits viewport

test_cases.input: Check navigation at mobile viewport
test_cases.expected: Hamburger menu icon is visible, full nav is hidden

test_cases.input: Click hamburger menu
test_cases.expected: Mobile navigation drawer/menu opens with all nav items

test_cases.input: Measure CTA button dimensions at mobile
test_cases.expected: Buttons have minimum touch target size of 44px

test_cases.input: Check hero section at mobile viewport
test_cases.expected: Hero content stacks vertically and remains readable

test_cases.input: Check navigation at tablet viewport
test_cases.expected: Navigation is appropriately styled for tablet (may show full or collapsed)

scenarios.name: Performance - Page Load Time
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage loads within acceptable time limits

steps.description: Clear cache to simulate first-time visitor
Set network throttling to 3G speed
steps.context: Per NFR-1: must load within 2 seconds on 3G

steps.description: Load the homepage and measure load time
steps.context: Measuring Time to First Contentful Paint

steps.description: Check that FCP is under 2 seconds

test_cases.input: Load homepage with network throttling to Fast 3G
test_cases.expected: First Contentful Paint occurs within 2000ms

test_cases.input: Measure Largest Contentful Paint
test_cases.expected: LCP occurs within 2500ms on 3G

test_cases.input: Check for Cumulative Layout Shift
test_cases.expected: CLS score is below 0.1

test_cases.input: Check animation properties in DevTools
